cases.title: North-West India, 4 January 2022 — the Day 8 forecast that busted

narrative.setup: On 4 January 2022 at 00Z the ensemble issued its Day 8 outlook for North-West India.
narrative.flag: Vishwas put the bust probability at 25%, against a climatological rate of about 5%.
narrative.why: See the drivers panel: the note explains which ensemble signals raised the risk.
narrative.outcome: The verifying analysis showed an error of 442 m² s⁻², above the 390 threshold for this region, lead and season. It busted.

cases.title: Indo-Gangetic Plain, 7 June 2022 — a Day 5 forecast worth trusting

narrative.setup: On 7 June 2022 at 00Z the ensemble issued its Day 5 outlook for Indo-Gangetic Plain.
narrative.flag: Vishwas put the bust probability at 0%: high confidence.
narrative.why: Spread was ordinary for the season, successive runs agreed, and the ensemble formed one coherent scenario.
narrative.outcome: The verifying analysis showed an error of 1 m² s⁻², well inside the 268 threshold. The forecast held.
